title: A health endpoint for the POC
brief: Tunnels and uptime checks need something cheap to hit. One phase.

subIssues.title: Add a GET /health endpoint to the POC
subIssues.brief: Add `GET /health` to the FastAPI app in poc/hg/app.py. It returns JSON: {"ok": true, "gate": <gate.enabled()>, "stories": <config.STORIES>}. No database access, no model call; it must answer in milliseconds so a tunnel or uptime check can use it. Add poc/tests/test_health.py that asserts the status code, the keys and that `ok` is true (use the fake model like the other tests). Don't touch anything else.
